FAQ

Q: Will these work with my email platform?
A: Yes - it's plain text/copy you paste into whatever platform you already use.

Q: Do I need to write anything myself?
A: You'll fill in bracketed placeholders ([Your Brand], [Lead Magnet], etc.) with your own details - the structure and copy are done for you.

Q: I don't have a big list yet. Is this still useful?
A: Yes - these sequences work at any list size and are meant to be set up once and run automatically as new people join.
